capabilities: Score note-to-note relevance from links, shared neighbours, frontmatter sources and co-citations
Detect Louvain communities with cohesion and mean intra-degree metrics
Surface insights such as suggested links, surprising links, structural risks and knowledge gaps
Overlay community colouring, association tooltips and an insights sidebar on the built-in graph
Export relevance reports as Markdown and filter the standalone graph by type, tag and structure
extras: Not yet listed in the community directory; the README includes Chinese interface terms and the plugin supports interface language selection. Verified against Obsidian 1.9.10 and 1.14.4; the built-in graph enhancement disables itself on unsupported app versions.
intentEvidence: an enhancement layer that overlays the same features on the built-in graph
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view only draws existing wikilinks and offers no relevance scoring, community detection or structural analysis of the vault.
summary: Graph analysis plugin that scores note relevance, detects Louvain communities and surfaces link and structure insights, overlaying the built-in graph.
